rows.text: with `o` = `rcx`, `x` = `edx`, `y` = `r8d`, `w` = `r9d`, `h` = the fifth-argument dword and `a` = float [o+0x20]: when `a` equals 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`; a NaN does not) stores `x`, `y`, `w` and `h` at dwords +0x24, +0x28, +0x2C and +0x30; otherwise, converting the zero-extended dwords to float and truncating back: `H` = trunc(w / a), `T` = trunc((h - H as a 32-bit difference) times 0.5 (`01CEBB70`)), `W` = trunc(h times a) and `S` = trunc((w - W, 32-bit) times 0.5); when `y` + `T` (32-bit) is non-zero and `H` is below `h` (unsigned) stores `x`, `y` + `T`, `w` and `H` at dwords +0x24 to +0x30, else `x` + `S`, `y`, `W` and `h`; both paths tail-jump to the vtable slot +0x20 of `o`
